# The Ashfall Reavers
The [color=#D9542B]Ashfall Reavers[/color] are what became of the mining crews, deserters and debtors the Colossus sector chewed up and spat out. They take their name from the ash belts of [textlink="Fervidus" link="Fervidus"], where the first of them hid.
## How they live
Reavers fly whatever they can patch together: beat-up civilian hulls, stolen freighters, and old [color=yellow]USSP[/color] warships left behind when the Union retreated. A captured Ledokol icebreaker serves some bands as a mobile stronghold.
They take what moves and cannot shoot back, then sell it on to anyone who does not ask. Both navies shoot them on sight. The Reavers return the favour.
## How they grow
A Reaver band that survives digs in. It raises a stronghold, rings it with gun batteries and sends out patrols. Strongholds left alone spread, reinforce and send raiding parties after stations and convoys. At their worst the bands unite behind a warlord and raise a citadel.
Their money comes from the Underground: every smuggled crate and fenced load of stolen freight ends up, sooner or later, paying for Reaver guns.
## Enemies
The Reavers fight everyone, but most of all the [textlink="ADS" link="WFLoreAds"]. The machines guard the cells and asteroids the Reavers want, and the two bleed each other across the sector map.
Planetside, Reaver encampments sit beside the roads of every world, and their APCs patrol the highways of Verda and Merak.
